summary: Completed comprehensive testing of detailed package system for ConstructONS. All 4 packages (Basic, Essential, Standard, Premium) now have deep spec categories with real Indian brand names, scope of work, exclusions, add-ons with prices, milestone-based payment schedules, and package-specific FAQs. New routes /packages/:slug and /packages/compare are fully functional. PDF brochure generation working correctly.
